answer: A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. Take away the forge and the name falls away; take away the prism and the stake falls away; take away the ledge and the whole past falls away. A real agent and a mask part ways at Goshawk trainer redtail proof flown at the aerie, and the parting line reads each redtail is a training record witnessed by the hawking clerk. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 144095 POA and 11635 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate shut already.
